verdict.rationale: Intuit Intelligence is documented as helping "resolve anomalies" and surfacing top-expense reports, and discrepancy reports exist for reconciliation. Intuit's official MCP server gives an agent read access to 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, with write-disable toggles, so it could scan the ledger. However, no evidence shows proactive, scheduled ledger monitoring or built-in duplicate-transaction detection. The anomaly-flagging logic would largely have to be built on the agent side. Missing for 10: documented proactive spend-anomaly monitoring of the ledger, explicit duplicate-transaction detection, pre-close alerting workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
